title: Action Verbs — Move Your Character
subtitle: Master the verbs that control your character in gaming
description: Master the verbs that control your character using imperatives — the language of gaming commands.
heroImagePrompt: A character sprinting through a massive open-world city at golden hour, buildings and streets stretching into the distance, motion blur, epic scale, GTA 6 style
imageStyle: ultra-realistic open-world video game graphics, GTA 6 aesthetic, photorealistic characters and environments, cinematic lighting, next-gen game engine quality, detailed textures, dynamic shadows, no text or HUD overlays

avatars.Coach: Photorealistic close-up portrait of a confident male gaming coach in his 30s, wearing a headset, urban street background, GTA 6 style graphics, dramatic lighting
avatars.Player: Photorealistic close-up portrait of a young female gamer in her early 20s, focused expression, casual gaming setup background, GTA 6 style graphics, dramatic lighting

vocabulary.definition: To leap upward or over something.
vocabulary.example: Press A to jump over the wall!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic game character mid-air leaping over a tall concrete wall in an urban environment, dynamic action pose, motion blur

vocabulary.example: Run to the exit before the timer ends!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character sprinting at full speed down a city street, motion blur on legs, urgent movement, open-world urban environment

vocabulary.definition: To fire a weapon at an enemy or target.
vocabulary.example: Press R2 to shoot the enemy.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character aiming a weapon at an enemy in a dramatic urban standoff, muzzle flash, realistic lighting, intense moment

vocabulary.definition: To quickly move out of the way of an attack.
vocabulary.example: Dodge left! The boss is attacking!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character diving sideways to avoid an explosion or attack, dust and debris flying, extreme action shot, open-world environment

vocabulary.definition: To lower your character's body to hide or avoid hits.
vocabulary.example: Crouch behind the wall to stay safe.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character crouching low behind a concrete barrier in a city alley, tense atmosphere, dramatic shadows, tactical gameplay moment

vocabulary.definition: To pick up items, coins, or power-ups.
vocabulary.example: Collect all the gold coins on this level.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character reaching down to pick up glowing coins or a power-up in an open world environment, golden light emanating from items

vocabulary.definition: To hit, strike, or fight against an enemy.
vocabulary.example: Attack the boss when his shield is down!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character delivering a powerful strike to a boss enemy in an epic battle scene, impact effects, dramatic lighting, intense combat

vocabulary.definition: To protect yourself or your team from damage.
vocabulary.example: Defend the base — enemies are coming!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character standing guard at a base entry point blocking an enemy advance, defensive stance, tense atmosphere, urban warfare setting

vocabulary.definition: To move upward on a wall, ladder, or surface.
vocabulary.example: Climb the ladder to reach the next level.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character climbing a metal ladder on the side of a tall building, cityscape visible below, dramatic height, golden hour lighting

vocabulary.definition: To push a button on the controller or keyboard.
vocabulary.example: Press X to interact with the NPC.
vocabulary.imagePrompt: Cinematic close-up of a thumb pressing a glowing controller button, dramatic lighting, dark background, photorealistic detail, game UI prompt visible

vocabulary.definition: To change the position of your character.
vocabulary.example: Move forward — there's a health pack ahead!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character advancing forward through an open-world street with a glowing health pack visible ahead, dynamic forward motion, cinematic framing

vocabulary.definition: To get away from an enemy or dangerous area.
vocabulary.example: Escape through the back door before it closes!
vocabulary.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character sprinting toward a closing back door with enemies in pursuit, dramatic tension, motion blur, urgent escape scene

phrasalVerbs.definition: The most common game tutorial phrase. Tells you which button to press.
phrasalVerbs.example: Press A to jump. Press B to attack.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: Photorealistic hands holding a game controller with glowing button prompts floating above it, tutorial UI style, dramatic lighting

phrasalVerbs.definition: Used to warn someone about danger coming towards them.
phrasalVerbs.example: Watch out! There's an enemy behind you!
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character turning around in alarm as an enemy approaches from behind in an urban environment, dramatic warning moment, tense atmosphere

phrasalVerbs.definition: A negative imperative — tells someone to keep moving continuously.
phrasalVerbs.example: Don't stop moving or they will catch you!
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character running at full speed being chased through city streets, urgency and speed, pursuers visible behind, cinematic action shot

phrasalVerbs.definition: Gives a teammate a tactical instruction for how to fight.
phrasalVerbs.example: Sneak around and attack from behind for extra damage.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character sneaking up behind an unaware enemy in a dark alley, stealth attack moment, dramatic shadows, tactical gameplay

phrasalVerbs.definition: Tells a teammate to move with you in the same direction.
phrasalVerbs.example: Follow me! I know the way to the boss room.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character gesturing forward to a teammate to follow through an open-world environment, leadership moment, cinematic wide shot

phrasalVerbs.phrase: climb up to the next level
phrasalVerbs.definition: Tells the player to move upward to progress in the game.
phrasalVerbs.example: Climb up to the next level to find the key.
phrasalVerbs.imagePrompt: A photorealistic character looking up at a tall structure they need to climb in an open-world setting, sense of scale and height, dramatic upward angle

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: OK everyone, tutorial time! [[press:to push a button on the controller]] the A button to start.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Done! Now what do I do?

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: [[jump:to leap upward or over something]] over that wall — press and hold A!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I jumped! But now there are enemies everywhere!

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: [[dodge:to quickly move out of the way of an attack]] left, then [[crouch:to lower your body to hide or avoid hits]] behind the big rock. Quickly!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: OK — I dodged! I'm crouching. Now can I [[attack:to hit, strike, or fight against an enemy]]?

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: Not yet! First [[collect:to pick up items, coins, or power-ups]] the power-up on your right. It will make you stronger.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Got it! Power-up collected. My HP is full now!

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: Good. Now [[run:to move your character quickly]] forward and [[attack:to hit, strike, or fight against an enemy]] the enemy. Don't stop!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I'm running! I attacked — the enemy is down! Do I need to [[escape:to get away from an enemy or dangerous area]] now?

dialogue.speaker: Coach
dialogue.text: No — [[climb:to move upward on a wall, ladder, or surface]] the ladder on the left. The exit is at the top. Move fast!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: I'm climbing! I can see the exit! Follow me, Coach — I'll [[defend:to protect yourself or your team from damage]] the top!
